record.original_question: Let (T (t))t≥0 be a contraction semigroup with generator A on a Hilbert space H. Consider the following properties: (i) There exists m ≥ 0 such that k(λ − A)xk ≥ m| Re λ|kxk for all Re λ < 0 and all x ∈ H. (ii) There exists m1 > 0 such that kT (t)xk ≥ m1 kxk for all t ≥ 0, x ∈ H. Does assertion (i) imply assertion (ii)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $H$ be a Hilbert space and let $(T(t))_{t\ge 0}$ be a strongly continuous contraction semigroup on $H$ with infinitesimal generator $A$ (so $\|T(t)\|\le 1$ for every $t\ge 0$). Consider the following two assertions.

(i) There exists a constant $m\ge 0$ such that
$$\|(\lambda - A)x\| \;\ge\; m\,|\operatorname{Re}\lambda|\,\|x\|$$
for every $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}$ with $\operatorname{Re}\lambda<0$ and every $x\in\operatorname{dom}(A)$.

(ii) There exists a constant $m_1>0$ such that
$$\|T(t)x\| \;\ge\; m_1\,\|x\|$$
for every $t\ge 0$ and every $x\in H$.

Question: Does assertion (i) imply assertion (ii)?
artifact.status_search_result: A direct search did not return a definitive resolution of whether the lower resolvent bound $\|(\lambda-A)x\|\ge m|\operatorname{Re}\lambda|\|x\|$ on the left half-plane implies a uniform lower bound $\|T(t)x\|\ge m_1\|x\|$ for contraction semigroups on Hilbert space. The question appears as an explicitly listed open problem on lower bounds for semigroups, and no source confirming a published solution was located.

status_evidence.title: A remark on the growth rate of operator semigroups under resolvent bounds
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on relating resolvent bounds to growth/decay of operator semigroups, in the spirit of Gearhart–Prüss.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature continues to investigate how resolvent estimates translate into semigroup norm estimates, indicating the topic is active rather than fully settled in the form asked.

status_evidence.title: Relation between semigroup growth and resolvent decay
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the relationship between resolvent decay and semigroup growth on Hilbert spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing research addresses exactly the kind of resolvent-to-semigroup implications featured in the problem.
